personality_one_liner: A precision command-center utility for physical motorcycle V6 Plus Bluetooth intercom audio routing validation and media TTS testing.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (min 56pt), strict 8pt grid rhythm, sticky primary actions at bottom with safe-area clearance.

do's: Use solid obsidian and graphite surfaces with high-contrast warm signal orange accents for maximum outdoor readability under helmet and sun conditions.
dont's: Avoid glassmorphism blur and low-contrast grey text to ensure compliance with command-center utility clarity.

screens.name: V6 Test
screens.purpose: Control V6 Plus audio test playback, test phrase verification, route status, and Repeat/Stop/Play commands.

states.loading: Checking Bluetooth adapter and connected V6 Plus sink states...
states.empty: No V6 Plus intercom paired or active in system audio routes.
states.error: Bluetooth adapter disabled or missing BLUETOOTH_CONNECT permission.

screens.layout: Vertical stack with top Bluetooth route status card, live output destination indicator, central Test Phrase display box ('Teste de áudio. Se você está ouvindo esta mensagem nos dois intercomunicadores, o compartilhamento de áudio está funcionando.'), large tactile primary action buttons for Play Test, Stop, and Repeat, followed by live event log feed.

screens.name: Audio Diagnostics
screens.purpose: Provide low-level inspection of Android AudioManager state, AudioAttributes (USAGE_MEDIA enforcement), Bluetooth profiles, and timestamped log events.

states.error: Failed to query system audio service.

screens.layout: Structured parameter rows displaying Audio Mode, Audio Attributes (USAGEMEDIA confirmed), active Bluetooth device address, connection profile, API level, and exportable timestamped log list with Clear Log action.

v6_hero_backdrop.alt: Motorcycle helmet with Bluetooth V6 intercom mounted on side

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Fase 1 utility app strictly per problem statement. Use Dark-First Utility theme (obsidian #121418 with signal orange #FF5722). Ensure TTS playback is explicitly routed as USAGE_MEDIA (never SCO or VoIP call mode). Include exact test phrase: 'Teste de áudio. Se você está ouvindo esta mensagem nos dois intercomunicadores, o compartilhamento de áudio está funcionando.'. Show Bluetooth V6 status, route availability, Reproduzir Teste, Parar, Repetir, and Audio Diagnostics screen with timestamped log. Minimum audio permissions only without microphone/location requests.
